name: Tommy Boy Records
ownershipStory: Founded by former dance-music journalist Tom Silverman, Tommy Boy released Afrika Bambaataa and Soulsonic Force's 'Planet Rock' and became one of the defining early hip-hop and electro labels.
hook: Released 'Planet Rock' and became the label electro and early hip-hop ran through.

blurb.age7: This company put out 'Planet Rock' and lots of early hip-hop records.
blurb.age13: Tommy Boy Records put out 'Planet Rock' in 1982 and went on to release many of the most important early hip-hop and electro records.
blurb.adult: Tommy Boy, founded by Tom Silverman in 1981, is the commercial engine behind much of early-1980s electro and hip-hop's crossover into wider pop culture.
